**Wedding Invitation**

With great joy and affectionate regard, we invite you to celebrate the marriage of

**Eleanor Grace Whitfield**
and
**Jonathan Alexander Reid**

on Saturday, the twelfth of September, two thousand twenty-six
at half past four in the afternoon

The ceremony will be held at
The Garden Chapel at Ashford Manor
142 Willow Lane, Hudson Valley, New York

A reception and dinner will follow in the Manor Ballroom at six o'clock.

Dress code: Formal attire.

We would be deeply honored by your presence as we begin this new chapter together. Kindly respond by the first of August at eleanorandreid2026.com/rsvp, or by telephone at (555) 202-0146.

With love and warmest regards,

**Mr. and Mrs. Thomas Whitfield**
and
**Dr. and Mrs. Marcus Reid**

---
